newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deuteche Telekom denies dismissal report.
newsitem.headline: Deuteche Telekom denies dismissal report.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG denied a report on Sunday that it planned to dismiss one of its board members, Herbert May, in the next few weeks.
Germany's weekly Spiegel magazine said in its latest edition that May would be dismissed after talks over allowing other telecommunications firms access to Deutsche's network broke down.
May is responsible for business clients at Telekom.

A spokeman for Telekom denied the report, saying it had "nothing in it." He said that, in any case, the access talks between Deutsche Telekom and media groups Kirch and Bertelsmann were being conducted by Franz Arnold, adding that this was nothing out of the ordinary.
